com.altastata.api

Class AccountRegistry

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.altastata.api.AccountRegistry

  • public final class AccountRegistry
extends java.lang.Object
    Process-wide registry that maps an AccountId to its single, shared AltaStataFileSystem instance.

    Not instantiable. All operations are exposed as static methods backed by a single JVM-wide map. There can only ever be one registry per JVM — two registries would partition the per-account caches and connection pools and defeat the whole purpose of the class. Without a registry, services running in the same JVM (the gRPC server and the S3 gateway hosting the same Bob account) would each construct their own AltaStataFileSystem, doubling RAM and re-fetching hot files from cloud storage on each side.

    Keying. The registry key is AccountId, the tuple (acccontainer-prefix, myuser, accounttype) derived from user_properties. Callers never construct AccountId themselves — the getOrCreate* convenience methods derive it from whatever input the caller already has (user-properties text, account dir, or a preloaded Account).

    Concurrency. Backed by ConcurrentHashMap; for a given AccountId the underlying AltaStataFileSystem constructor is invoked at most once for the lifetime of the JVM (or until invalidate(AltaStataFileSystem) is called). Construction runs while holding the map's bin lock; if real-world construction proves too long under contention, switch to an outer per-key lock pattern.

    Eviction. ConcurrentHashMap never evicts. Use invalidate(AltaStataFileSystem) from explicit logout / revocation hooks. Re-visit if RAM accumulation in long-running services becomes a problem.

    Since:
    1.0

    • Method Detail

      • getOrCreate

        public static AltaStataFileSystem getOrCreate(java.lang.String userProperties,
                                              java.lang.String privateKeyEncrypted)
        Returns the existing AltaStataFileSystem for the account identified by userProperties, or atomically constructs one and stores it. The AltaStataFileSystem constructor is package-private; this is one of three public paths to it (see also getOrCreateFromDir(java.lang.String) and getOrCreateForAccount(com.altastata.utils.Account)).

        Callers must invoke fs.setPassword(...) on the returned filesystem afterwards. If setPassword throws, call invalidate(AltaStataFileSystem) so a retry with the correct password gets a fresh instance instead of reusing the half-initialized one.

        Parameters:
        userProperties - raw user_properties text (mandatory)
        privateKeyEncrypted - encrypted private-key PEM, or null/empty for HSM-backed accounts
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if userProperties is null or doesn't contain all three identity fields

      • getOrCreateFromDir

        public static AltaStataFileSystem getOrCreateFromDir(java.lang.String accountDirPath)
        Returns the existing AltaStataFileSystem for the account stored in accountDirPath, or atomically constructs one from disk and stores it.
        Parameters:
        accountDirPath - absolute path to the account directory containing exactly one *user.properties file and the encrypted private-key PEM
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if accountDirPath is null, not a directory, has no/multiple *user.properties files, or the file is missing an identity field

      • getOrCreateFromUpload

        public static AltaStataFileSystem getOrCreateFromUpload(java.lang.String userProperties,
                                                        java.util.Map<java.lang.String,byte[]> accountFiles)
        Returns the existing AltaStataFileSystem for the account identified by userProperties, or atomically constructs one from an in-memory upload (LoginV2.upload / Python map).

        Always materializes accountFiles into a process-local temp directory (basenames only) and loads via AltaStataFileSystem.AltaStataFileSystem(String). That directory is removed when the registry entry is invalidated.

        Typical keys (pass only what the account needs; future files fit the same map without API changes):

        • private.key — RSA (required unless HPCS/HSM)
        • license.jwt + org-ca.pem — Enterprise / eval
        • org-ca-private.key — custodian local signing only
        • HPCS / PQC key material as needed
        Parameters:
        userProperties - raw *user.properties text (mandatory)
        accountFiles - account files keyed by basename → content
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if userProperties is null, identity fields are missing, or required key files are absent

      • getOrCreateForAccount

        public static AltaStataFileSystem getOrCreateForAccount(com.altastata.utils.Account account)
        Returns the existing AltaStataFileSystem for the account already loaded into account, or atomically wraps it in a fresh AltaStataFileSystem and stores it.

        If a different Account object with the same AccountId was registered earlier, that prior instance wins and the account argument is discarded.

        Parameters:
        account - already-built Account (must not be null, must have all three identity properties set)
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if account is null or missing an identity field

      • get

        public static AltaStataFileSystem get(AccountId id)
        Returns the currently-cached AltaStataFileSystem for id, or null if no entry exists. Read-only; does not construct anything.

      • invalidate

        public static boolean invalidate(AltaStataFileSystem fs)
        Removes fs from the registry if it is the currently-cached filesystem for its own accountId. This is the logout / revocation / bad-password hook.

        Conditional removal (vs. blind Map.remove(Object)) is important: a concurrent getOrCreate(java.lang.String, java.lang.String) call may already have replaced the entry with a fresh, correctly-initialized AltaStataFileSystem, and we must not evict that one when cleaning up after our own failed init.

        Parameters:
        fs - the filesystem to invalidate; ignored if null
        Returns:
        true if the entry was actually removed, false if fs was null or no longer the cached instance

      • invalidate

        public static AltaStataFileSystem invalidate(AccountId accountId)
        Removes whichever filesystem is currently registered for accountId, regardless of its state. Prefer invalidate(AltaStataFileSystem) when the caller already holds the AltaStataFileSystem reference; this overload exists for admin paths that only know the identity.
        Parameters:
        accountId - account identity to evict; ignored if null
        Returns:
        the previously-cached filesystem, or null if absent

      • clearForTesting

        public static void clearForTesting()
        FOR TEST CODE ONLY. Empties the registry. Required in @Before / @BeforeEach: Gradle shares one JVM across test classes by default, so without this, mappings from one test pollute the next.
